args.content: {"success_rate": 1.0, "episodes_run": 20, "notes": "Right-hand (left if bag y>0) punch via WholeBody IK with both feet fixed and ComFeedback balance; 20/20 seeds on practice bag (0.38,-0.15,1) swung the bag 34-39 cm with max tilt <4 deg. Bags at x>=0.45 are at the edge of reach and less reliable (some miss)."}

text:
The controller works on the practice setup: 20 of 20 seeds (0–19) struck the bag and stayed standing, so the success rate is 1.0. Each punch swung the bag 34–39 cm, well past the 0.2 m needed. Maximum torso tilt stayed under 4°.

The controller is in `controller.py`. It keeps both feet planted and uses `WholeBody` to move the hand to a wind-up point, then punches through the bag centre. It uses the right hand, or the left if the bag is at y > 0. It leans the centre of mass forward a little as the arm extends, with `ComFeedback` correcting balance. The punch takes 0.15 s, and the episode then ends at 3.5 s.

I also tried other bag positions with seed 1. Bags up to about x = 0.42 worked in the cases I ran. At x = 0.45 and beyond, results were mixed. For example, (0.45, 0, 1) succeeded, while (0.45, −0.05, 0.9) and (0.5, −0.1, 1) swung the bag less than 0.2 m. That is the edge of reach with the feet planted.

I tuned the forward lean (a fixed 5 cm shift made the robot fall on the practice setup), so it now scales with how far away the bag is. I did not re-run all the off-practice positions after that last change. The report counts only the 20 practice-setup episodes.

The 20 final motion files are in `live/` as `final_s0` to `final_s19`, each ending in `.motion.json`. `report.json` is written.
